# sherpa-filter-stack

The panel area's filters: ONE filter toolbar per scope, each turned to PORTRAIT. The toolbars are the filters; this only stacks them, and opens and shuts as the panel area's occupant. TODO 425

## When to use it

In the app shell's panel area, for the page's filters as a column: one filter toolbar per scope, each in portrait. It asks a provider for its scopes; the toolbars are the filters. For one scope's filters in a strip, use `sherpa-quick-filter-toolbar`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-filter-stack data-scope="view data" open></sherpa-filter-stack>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-saveable` | boolean |  | its component scopes' toolbars save filters |
| `data-scope` | text |  | the scopes it asks for, space-separated, as a panel does |
| `open` | boolean, native | `false` | showing . Every close reports, and says why. |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `drawScopes(scopes: readonly ScopeDescription[])` | drawScopes(scopes) — one portrait toolbar per scope, in order; each asks for its own scope, as any toolbar does. A scope gone takes its toolbar; one already here is not moved, so it keeps what the reader did. The FIRST takes the page's mode button. |
| `show()` |  |
| `hide(reason: 'reader' \| 'width' \| 'page' = 'reader')` | EVERY close reports, and says why. |
| `close(reason: 'reader' \| 'width' \| 'page' = 'reader')` |  |
| `toggle()` |  |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `filter-panel-close` | `{ reason: 'page' \| 'reader' \| 'width' }` | It shut, and why: the reader, the width or the page. |
